post.description: Hashes the password (bcrypt cost 12) and optionally assigns role slugs in the same transaction. Cannot create a user in another school — `school_id` is taken from the caller.

get.description: Paginated and school-scoped. Soft-deleted users are excluded. Filters: `search` (substring on name/email), `role` (slug), `status`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match against name or email.

get.description: Cross-school requests return 404, never 403, so user IDs are not enumerable across tenants.
get.summary: Get one user by id (principal, vice_principal)

patch.description: Cannot change email, school_id, or roles. Switching status to `inactive`/`suspended` bumps the user's `tokenVersion` and revokes every active refresh token (BR-USR-07).

delete.description: Sets `deleted_at`, bumps `tokenVersion`, and revokes every active refresh token. The principal cannot delete their own account.

post.description: Idempotent — assigning a role the user already holds is a no-op. The actor is recorded in user_roles.assigned_by.
post.summary: Assign a role to a user (principal only)

404.description: User or role mapping not found

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user (principal only)

post.description: Hashes the supplied password with bcrypt cost 12, bumps `tokenVersion`, and revokes every active refresh token for the target user (`admin_action`).
post.summary: Reset another user's password (principal only) — BR-USR-05

get.description: Returns the seeded role catalog. Used by the user-management UI to populate role pickers and by anywhere that needs to map between numeric ids and slugs.

post.description: On success, returns an access token and the user view, and sets the `refresh_token` cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=`/auth`). All failure paths — bad password, unknown email, inactive account, rate-limited, lockout — return the same `401 Invalid credentials` shape.
post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Reads the `refresh_token` cookie. Replaying a rotated/revoked token revokes the entire token family and returns 401 (BR-AUTH-07).

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked refresh cookie

post.summary: Rotate the refresh cookie and mint a new access token

post.description: Idempotent — clears the cookie either way and never reveals whether the token was valid.
Kills every device session for the authenticated user. Existing access tokens still work until they expire (15 min); see BR-USR-07 for cut-on-next-request via `tokenVersion`.
post.summary: Revoke every refresh token for the caller

post.description: Always returns 200 with the same message regardless of whether the email exists — never reveals membership. The reset token is one-time, valid for 1 hour.

get.description: Read-only — does not consume the token, bump tokenVersion, or revoke anything. Used by the reset-password page to render the email and gate the form.
get.summary: Check whether a reset token is currently usable

get.description: Authorization is role-based — the response carries a flat `roles` slug array and intentionally no `permissions` field.

post.description: `password` and `password_confirmation` must match (validated before any DB work). On success: bumps `tokenVersion`, revokes every active refresh token (`password_change`), and marks the reset token used.
post.summary: Consume a reset token and set a new password

post.description: Verifies the current password before applying. Revokes every other refresh token for the user (`password_change`); the caller's current refresh cookie keeps working so the active session is preserved. Mounted under `/auth` so the cookie (Path=`/api/auth`) is in scope.

get.description: Returns one entry per active refresh token. The entry for the device that owns the current cookie is flagged with `current: true`.
get.summary: List active sessions for the caller

delete.description: Revokes the refresh token row identified by `id` if and only if it belongs to the caller. Cross-user requests return 404, never 403, so token IDs are not enumerable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Refresh token row id (BIGINT as string)

404.description: Session not found or not owned by caller

patch.description: Whitelist enforced via DTO + global `forbidNonWhitelisted` — sending `email`, `school_id`, `status`, or `roles` returns 400 (BR-USR-06).

get.description: Results are scoped by role: principal/vice_principal see all in the school; supervisor/teacher see students in their halaqat; parent sees only their linked children. Supports pagination and filters.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: When true, soft-deleted students are also returned (principal/vice_principal only).

get.summary: List students visible to the caller

post.description: Principal/vice_principal only. Daily-page capacities default to 1/5/10 (hifz/near/far) when omitted (BR-STD-02). Guardians may be linked inline.

get.description: Visibility enforced by `StudentScopeGuard` — returns 404 instead of 403 when the student is out of scope.

patch.description: Principal/vice_principal can edit any field. Teachers may only adjust daily-page capacities and notes (other fields in the body are ignored for teacher-only callers).

delete.description: Sets `deleted_at`. The student is hidden from default queries but recoverable via `/restore`.

post.description: Sets status to `graduated` and stamps the graduation date (defaults to today when omitted).

get.description: Visibility follows the same scope rules as `GET /students/:id`. Ordered by link-creation time.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Student id (path param `:id` from the parent route).

get.summary: List guardians linked to a student

post.description: Either reference an existing parent user (`guardian_user_id`) or create one inline (`email` + `name`). Setting `is_primary: true` demotes any existing primary on the student (BR-STD-04).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Student id (path param `:id` from the parent route).

post.summary: Link a guardian to a student

patch.description: Adjust relation, primary flag, or pickup permission. Promoting one guardian to primary demotes the existing primary.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Student id (path param `:id` from the parent route).

delete.description: Removes the link only — does not delete the guardian user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Student id (path param `:id` from the parent route).

delete.summary: Unlink a guardian from a student

get.description: Parent-only. Returns every (non-deleted) student that this user is linked to as a guardian, newest first. The list is unpaginated — `page` and `limit` mirror the total for client compatibility.
Parent-only. Returns 404 (not 403) if the student isn’t linked to the caller — never reveals existence.
get.summary: Get one of the caller’s children with guardians

info.title: Halaqa Backend API
info.description: Authentication, user management, and school operations for the Halaqa system. All JSON responses are wrapped in a uniform envelope: `{ "code": <http>, "data": ... }` on success, `{ "code": <http>, "message": "..." }` on errors. Refresh tokens travel as HttpOnly cookies on `/auth/*`; access tokens use Bearer auth.
